title: Unit Review: Demography and the Language of Data
goal: Review collective agreement, trend periphrases, de lo que comparisons, approximations and cautious data claims.
grammar: Unit Review: Demography and the Language of Data

items: I can apply collective and partitive verb agreement accurately in demographic statements.
I can describe gradual shifts, peaks and deviations from forecasts with *ir* + gerund, *llegar a* and *de lo que*.
I can report percentages, approximations and cautious interpretations without overstating causation.
